title: Hyperdimensional Probe: Decoding LLM Representations via Vector Symbolic Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2509.25045v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite their capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain opaque with limited understanding of their internal representations. Current interpretability methods either focus on input-oriented feature extraction, such as supervised probes and Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), or on output distribution inspection, such as logit-oriented approaches. A full understanding of LLM vector spaces, however, requires integrating both perspectives, something existing approaches struggle with due to constraints on latent feature definitions. We introduce the Hyperdimensional Probe, a hybrid supervised probe that combines symbolic representations with neural probing. Leveraging Vector Symbolic Architectures (VSAs) and hypervector algebra, it unifies prior methods: the top-down interpretability of supervised probes, SAE's sparsity-driven proxy space, and output-oriented logit investigation. translated_title: 超维探针：基于向量符号架构解码大语言模型表示
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）具有强大的能力，但其内部仍然是不透明的，人们对其内部表示的理解十分有限。目前的可解释性方法要么专注于面向输入的特征提取，例如有监督探针和稀疏自编码器（SAE），要么专注于输出分布检查，例如面向logit的方法。然而，要全面理解LLM的向量空间，需要将这两种视角整合起来，而现有方法由于潜在特征定义上的限制，难以做到这一点。我们提出了超维探针，这是一种将符号表示与神经探测相结合的混合式有监督探针。通过利用向量符号架构（VSA）和超向量代数，它统一了先前的方法：有监督探针的自顶向下可解释性、SAE由稀疏性驱动的代理空间，以及面向输出的logit研究。通过结合传统的有监督学习范式……
tldr: 提出超维探针——一种结合向量符号架构与神经探测的混合式有监督探针，统一了有监督探针、稀疏自编码器和logit分析等可解释性方法，从而更全面地解码大语言模型的内部表示。
en_tdlr: Introduces the Hyperdimensional Probe, a hybrid supervised probe combining Vector Symbolic Architectures with neural probing that unifies prior interpretability methods—supervised probes, SAEs, and logit analysis—to more comprehensively decode LLM internal representations.
